text:
My héroe desnuda his nervios a it largo of my cintura

that rige of the cintura until the hombros,

desenvuelve the head that, as a fantasma soñoliento,

is apoya in my mortal regidor,

the espinazo altivo that desprecia the giros and torsiones.

And estos pobres nervios tan atados to the cráneo

duelen over the papel abandonado for his amante

I me abrazo to the love with my garabateo revoltoso

that gime all the hambre of love

and le cuenta a the página his vacío infortunio.

My héroe desnuda my costado and ve a his heart

that marcha as Venus desnuda

for the playa of carne and enrosca his ensangrentado pliegue;

to the despojar my lomos of promesas

promete cierto calor secreto.

Él sostiene the cables of esta caja of nervios

alabando the error mortal

of the nacimiento and of the death, esas dos tristes sotas of ladrones.

and the hambre is emperador; tira él of the cadena, the cisterna is agita.

translation.title: My héroe desnuda his nervios
